propositions: Current clarity_score rewards generic volume (headings, character length, bullets) and type-specific bonuses but ignores author-guide leaf/container contract shape; padded plans can pass without required Scope, Approach, or per-criterion verification.
Clarity measure logic is duplicated in gates.py and det_floor.py with inconsistent implementations (latter lacks bug branch), inviting drift during future extension.

Seven recommended deterministic additions exist for section shape, AC verification coverage, placeholder detection, file-impact grounding, AC hygiene, Testing markers, and structural completeness, but preserving LLM review for semantic quality.
Author guide documents Success Criteria as required for containers, but active epic and G2 criteria classify it as collapsed into Acceptance Criteria; test suite confirms inert behavior.

AC verification coverage (operator-attested or explicit proving clauses) and placeholder-free executable scope (case-insensitive lexicon matching for TBD, figure out, verify whether, etc.) are mechanically testable without semantic judgment.

Scoring model should return per-check evidence and derive compatibility from satisfied/applicable checks rather than cumulative points, preventing filler from compensating for missing required sections.
